en.r: Black Fork Mountain Wilderness is a wilderness area in the United States. It covers 54.5 km² and has been protected since 1984. It is managed by the U.S. Forest Service. Under the IUCN system it is a wilderness area: a large, largely unmodified space without permanent infrastructure.

Fica junto ao lago Great Salt Plains, de 38 km² e 66 km de margem, raso, com profundidade média de 1,2 metro, e salgado, com um quarto da salinidade da água do mar. en.r: Great Salt Plains State Park is a state park in Oklahoma, United States. It covers 35.3 km².
en.h: An 840-acre (3.4 km2) Oklahoma state park in Alfalfa County, 8 miles north of Jet. It lies on Great Salt Plains Lake, 9,300 acres with 41 miles of shoreline, shallow, averaging 4 feet deep, and salty, with a quarter of seawater's salinity. It offers boating, camping, swimming, hiking and mountain biking.
en.ff: The lake offers fishing for catfish, saugeye, sandbass and hybrid striper.

es.ff: El lago tiene pesca de bagre, saugeye, sandbass y lubina híbrida.

en.r: Lake Eufaula State Park is a state park in Oklahoma, United States. It has been protected since 1965.
en.h: A 2,853-acre (11.55 km2) Oklahoma state park on Lake Eufaula in McIntosh County, 14 miles (23 km) southwest of Checotah. Created in 1965 as Fountainhead State Park, along with neighboring Arrowhead, it took its current name in 2002; Arrowhead became an area of the same park. It has a beach, boat ramps, a marina, year-round fishing, the Deep Fork Nature Center and hiking, mountain bike and equestrian trails.

en.h: A 1,100 ha state park in southern Oklahoma on the south side of 1,500 ha McGee Creek Reservoir, created in 1985 for flood control. With the lake and the wildlife management area, the protected land around the lake totals about 81 km². It is linked to McGee Creek Natural Scenic Recreation Area.
en.ff: Bear and deer live here; shortleaf pine, near its western limit, is abundant. Anglers fish for crappie, sunfish, largemouth bass and channel catfish.

en.ff: White-tailed deer are often seen; there are over 85 bird species, such as wild turkeys, cardinals, herons and blue grosbeaks, plus great horned owls, red-tailed hawks and even bald eagles.

en.r: Sequoyah State Park is a state park in Oklahoma, United States.
en.h: A 2,200-acre peninsula park on the east shore of Fort Gibson Lake, Cherokee County, Oklahoma, between Wagoner and Tahlequah. It has Oklahoma's largest state park lodge.
at: 12 miles of trails, including the Fossil Trail
Paradise Cove Marina and trail rides

at: Western end of the Ouachita National Recreation Trail, 359 km through the Ouachita Mountains

pt.r: O Tenkiller State Park é um parque estadual em Oklahoma, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 54,7 km² e está protegido desde 1952.
pt.h: Parque de 1.190 acres no condado de Sequoyah, Oklahoma, perto de Vian e Gore, à beira do lago Tenkiller, o sexto maior reservatório do estado. A oeste fica a área de manejo de fauna Tenkiller, de 2.590 acres.
pt.ff: Veados, codornas, pombas, patos, gansos, coelhos e esquilos na área de fauna vizinha.

en.r: Tenkiller State Park is a state park in Oklahoma, United States. It covers 54.7 km² and has been protected since 1952.
en.h: A 1,190-acre park in Sequoyah County, Oklahoma, near Vian and Gore, on Lake Tenkiller, the state's sixth-largest reservoir. The 2,590-acre Tenkiller Wildlife Management Area lies to the west.
en.ff: Deer, quail, dove, ducks, geese, rabbits and squirrels in the neighbouring wildlife area.

es.r: El Tenkiller State Park es un parque estatal en Oklahoma, Estados Unidos. Tiene 54,7 km² y está protegido desde 1952.
es.h: Parque de 1.190 acres en el condado de Sequoyah, Oklahoma, cerca de Vian y Gore, a orillas del lago Tenkiller, el sexto mayor embalse del estado. Al oeste está el área de manejo de fauna Tenkiller, de 2.590 acres.
es.ff: Ciervos, codornices, palomas, patos, gansos, conejos y ardillas en el área de fauna vecina.

pt.r: O Twin Bridges State Park é um parque estadual em Oklahoma, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 28 hectares e está protegido desde 1954, sob gestão do governo estadual.
pt.h: Parque na margem norte do Grand Lake o' the Cherokees, no nordeste de Oklahoma, hoje parte do Grand Lake State Park. O nome vem das duas pontes da US-60 sobre braços do lago ligados aos rios Neosho e Spring. É conhecido pelo clima tranquilo de interior.
pt.ff: A pesca é excelente, com achigãs de troféu, bagres, bluegills e peixes-espátula; o parque abriga o centro de pesquisa de peixe-espátula do departamento de vida selvagem do estado.
at: Pesca, com centro de iscas e equipamento e píer de pesca coberto
Campings para trailers e barracas e cabanas à beira do lago
Centro de Pesquisa e Processamento de Peixe-espátula

en.r: Twin Bridges State Park is a state park in Oklahoma, United States. It covers 28 hectares and has been protected since 1954. It is managed by the state government.
en.h: A park on the north side of Grand Lake o' the Cherokees in northeastern Oklahoma, now part of Grand Lake State Park. It is named for the two US-60 bridges over arms of the lake that connect to the Neosho and Spring rivers. It is known for its quiet country atmosphere.
en.ff: Fishing is excellent for trophy bass, catfish, bluegill and paddlefish; the park is home to the state Wildlife Department's paddlefish research center.
at: Fishing, with a bait and tackle center and an enclosed fishing dock
RV and tent campgrounds and lake huts

es.r: El Twin Bridges State Park es un parque estatal en Oklahoma, Estados Unidos. Tiene 28 hectáreas y está protegido desde 1954, bajo la gestión del gobierno estatal.
es.h: Parque en la orilla norte del Grand Lake o' the Cherokees, en el noreste de Oklahoma, hoy parte del Grand Lake State Park. El nombre viene de los dos puentes de la US-60 sobre brazos del lago unidos a los ríos Neosho y Spring. Es conocido por su ambiente rural y tranquilo.
es.ff: La pesca es excelente, con lobinas de trofeo, bagres, bluegills y peces espátula; el parque alberga el centro de investigación del pez espátula del departamento de fauna del estado.
at: Pesca, con centro de carnadas y equipo y muelle de pesca cubierto
Campings para casas rodantes y tiendas, y cabañas junto al lago
El Centro de Investigación y Procesamiento del Pez Espátula

pt.r: A Upper Kiamichi River Wilderness é uma área selvagem em Oklahoma, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 40 km² e está protegida desde 1988, sob gestão do Serviço Florestal dos EUA. Na classificação da IUCN, é uma área silvestre: um grande espaço pouco alterado, sem infraestrutura permanente.
pt.h: Área selvagem de 9.754 acres criada pelo Congresso em 1988 na Floresta Nacional Ouachita, Oklahoma. As serras Pine Mountain e Rich Mountain passam de 792 m, e riachos e cachoeiras que descem delas formam as nascentes do rio Kiamichi.
pt.ff: Faias, em geral bem mais ao norte, com pinheiros e carvalhos; ursos-negros, veados-de-cauda-branca, linces e gambás.
at: Cristas mais altas do leste de Oklahoma

en.r: Upper Kiamichi River Wilderness is a wilderness area in Oklahoma, United States. It covers 40 km² and has been protected since 1988. It is managed by the U.S. Forest Service. Under the IUCN system it is a wilderness area: a large, largely unmodified space without permanent infrastructure.
en.h: A 9,754-acre wilderness created by Congress in 1988 in Ouachita National Forest, Oklahoma. Pine Mountain and Rich Mountain rise above 2,600 feet, and streams and waterfalls running off them form the headwaters of the Kiamichi River.
en.ff: Beech, usually found much farther north, with pine and oak; black bears, white-tailed deer, bobcats and skunks.
at: 7 miles of the Ouachita National Recreation Trail

es.r: La Upper Kiamichi River Wilderness es un área silvestre en Oklahoma, Estados Unidos. Tiene 40 km² y está protegida desde 1988, bajo la gestión del Servicio Forestal de EE. UU.. En la clasificación de la UICN es un área silvestre: un gran espacio poco alterado, sin infraestructura permanente.
es.h: Área silvestre de 9.754 acres creada por el Congreso en 1988 en el Bosque Nacional Ouachita, Oklahoma. Las sierras Pine Mountain y Rich Mountain superan los 792 m, y los arroyos y cascadas que bajan de ellas forman las nacientes del río Kiamichi.
es.ff: Hayas, por lo general mucho más al norte, con pinos y robles; osos negros, ciervos de cola blanca, linces y zorrillos.
at: 11 km de la Ouachita National Recreation Trail
Crestas más altas del este de Oklahoma

t.pt: A Wichita Mountains Wilderness é uma área selvagem em Oklahoma, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 34,7 km² e está protegida desde 1970, sob gestão do Serviço de Pesca e Vida Selvagem dos EUA. Na classificação da IUCN, está na categoria IV: o manejo é voltado a habitats e espécies específicos.
t.en: Wichita Mountains Wilderness is a wilderness area in Oklahoma, United States. It covers 34.7 km² and has been protected since 1970. It is managed by the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service. Under the IUCN system it is category IV: management focuses on particular habitats and species.
t.es: La Wichita Mountains Wilderness es un área silvestre en Oklahoma, Estados Unidos. Tiene 34,7 km² y está protegida desde 1970, bajo la gestión del Servicio de Pesca y Vida Silvestre de EE. UU.. En la clasificación de la UICN está en la categoría IV: la gestión se centra en hábitats y especies concretos.
